title: LinkedIn Lead Generation Services in India: A B2B Guide
description: A B2B buyer's guide to LinkedIn lead generation services in India: what they include, the types on offer, what to ask a vendor and what results to expect.
author: Yogansh Banthia

faq_heading: Questions Indian B2B teams ask about LinkedIn lead generation services

faqs.q: What does a LinkedIn lead generation service include?
faqs.a: Most services agree your ideal buyer with you, build a list of matching people, send connection requests and messages, follow up, and hand interested replies to your sales team. Good ones also show you every invite, reply and lead so you can see what is working.

faqs.q: Is LinkedIn lead generation worth it for B2B companies in India?
faqs.a: It is worth it when you sell to other businesses, one deal is worth a meaningful amount, and your buyers are active on LinkedIn. It is usually not worth it for consumer products or very low-value sales.

faqs.q: How long does LinkedIn lead generation take to show results?
faqs.a: Accepted invites usually start in the first weeks, and conversations build as follow-ups go out. Clara AI aims to show you a first demo within 7 days of getting your material.

faqs.q: Will a LinkedIn lead generation service put my account at risk?
faqs.a: It can, if it sends at high volume with templates. LinkedIn's User Agreement does not allow bots or unapproved automated methods. Ask any vendor how many invites a day they send, and choose one that works at a human pace with a person checking the setup.

faqs.q: Who is a LinkedIn lead generation service not right for?
faqs.a: It is not right for consumer brands that want followers or likes, for one-off posting, or for teams with no budget for a paid monthly service. It is built for B2B firms selling to other businesses.
